name: Z-CJIS Markings-Monitor
description: Monitor outbound content with explicit CJIS / CHRI / LES markings. Covers banner and portion markings anywhere in the document.

name: Z-CJIS Identifier-Monitor
description: Monitor structured CJIS identifiers — NCIC ORI, FBI UCN, SID, NCIC Purpose Code. Any such identifier leaving the tenant is logged for review.

name: Z-CJIS Criminal History-Monitor
description: Monitor transmission of criminal-history records (RAP sheets, booking reports, incident reports) when they co-occur with subject PII.

name: Z-CJIS NCIC III Data-Monitor
description: Monitor NCIC / III query results (wanted persons, stolen property, missing persons) correlated with subject PII.

name: Z-CJIS Warrants-Monitor
description: Monitor wanted-person / warrant content near subject PII — flags accidental or intentional exfil of active-warrant data.

name: Z-CJIS Biometric-Monitor
description: Monitor biometric references (fingerprint, palm, AFIS/IAFIS/NGI, booking photo) that co-occur with CJIS markings or structured identifiers.

name: Z-CJIS NICS Firearms-Monitor
description: Monitor NICS / firearm background-check terminology — ATF Form 4473, NICS denials, prohibited-person content.

name: Z-CJIS Info-Sharing-Monitor
description: Monitor egress of content derived from LE info-sharing portals (N-DEx, LEEP, Nlets, RISS) when coupled with subject identifiers.

name: Z-CJIS Any-Signal-Monitor
description: Broad catch-all — any high-signal CJIS marking or structured identifier. Useful as a safety net while tuning the narrower policies above.

name: Z-CJIS Markings [Endpoint]
description: Endpoint DLP: the same detection as the inline rule "Z-CJIS Markings-Monitor" (CJIS Markings High Confidence). Monitor-only; enable after reviewing incidents.
